answer: The bridge report makes public the merge explicitly at each willow. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 175 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 145 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one horizon weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The per-identity price is 19 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
